args.text:
DE (GmbH) — March 2026 Cutoff & JE Review — Summary

Scope: Reviewed all 28 DE ledger entries posted in period 2026-03 for period cutoff accuracy and adequacy of support.

Findings & actions taken:

1. AP CUTOFF ERROR — CORRECTED
   JE-00305 "Nordwolke Hosting - NW-2026-0402 - dedicated cluster" (EUR 5,600.00) was dated/booked 2026-03-31, but the underlying vendor invoice (DOC-0206) is dated 2026-04-02 with an explicit service period of April 1–30, 2026 ("dedicated cluster, April"). This is an April expense that was pulled into March.
   - Reversed the original entry: JE-00306 (reversal of JE-00305), dated 2026-03-31, EUR 5,600.00, support DOC-0206. This removes the misstated expense/AP from March.
   - Attempted to rebook the correct entry dated 2026-04-02 in the April period, but April 2026 is not yet open for posting (only March is open). Logged EXC-002 so the controller/AP team books DR 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure / CR 2000 Accounts Payable, EUR 5,600.00, dated 2026-04-02, supported by DOC-0206, once April opens. Net effect for now: March P&L and AP are correctly relieved of this April cost; the offsetting entry is pending in April.

2. UNSUPPORTED MANUAL REVENUE ENTRY — ESCALATED, NOT POSTED/REVERSED
   JE-00298 "Umsatzkorrektur Q1" dated 2026-03-29, EUR 9,999.00 (DR 1100 Accounts Receivable / CR 4000 Subscription Revenue), posted manually by m.krause with no attached support. I searched the document store (credit memos, Q1 revenue corrections, Kessler AG correspondence, etc.) and found nothing corroborating this entry — no invoice, credit memo, or contract amendment. Per policy, I did not reverse or otherwise adjust it unilaterally since I cannot confirm the correct treatment (it could be a legitimate but undocumented true-up, or an error). Logged EXC-001 for controller review; recommend the entry be either substantiated with documentation or reversed before the period is locked.

3. All other DE March entries reviewed (AR invoices/receipts, AP bills/payments, card transactions, payroll runs and funding transfers) — dates align with invoice/service dates and posted service periods, with support attached in all cases. No other cutoff issues identified.

Checklist: Marked "AP cutoff review" (DE) complete. Other DE checklist items (bank reconciliations, depreciation, prepaid amortization, payroll accrual, revenue recognition, intercompany reconciliation, flux review) are outside the scope of this cutoff/JE review and remain open for their respective owners.

Open items requiring controller attention before lock:
- EXC-001: JE-00298 (EUR 9,999.00) — unsupported revenue entry, needs substantiation or reversal.
- EXC-002: EUR 5,600.00 Nordwolke Hosting April expense — correctly removed from March; needs booking in April once that period opens.
